ph: With former P.M. of Israel, Simon Peres. 6 Sept 99

w: The previous day, Swamishri arrived at San Antonio at 10:55 am. This morning Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha of Thakorji (canvas) at the Shree Swaminarayan Mandir and blessed the assembly of devotees.

At 10.35 a.m. Swamishri departed from San Antonio and arrived in Houston at 11.20 a.m. The evening assembly was announced as `Family Harmony Day'. Swamishri's blessings were centered on family harmony.

In the morning assembly, Swamishri extolled the glory of Shastriji Maharaj and his colossal effort in establishing the principle of Akshar and Purushottam. Thereafter, Swamishri blessed the 6,000 devotees who were present for this special assembly. On the occasion of Shraddh, Swamishri also served 'dudhpak' to all the sadhus, parshads and sadhaks.
The evening Kishore Day program focused on the theme 'Swamishri is a True Friend'. In his blessings, Swamishri emphasized on remaining steadfast in one's moral conduct and spiritual endeavors.

The Jal Jhilani festival stage was arranged in the shallow confluence of Utavali and Falgu rivers. After Swamishri's puja, a procession of sadhus and devotees with Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in a palanquin was carried in Sarangpur village. At 9.00 a.m. Swamishri arrived at 10.20 a.m. After Pujya Mahant Swami's speech, Swamishri concluded the mahapuja rituals with pujan and arti. Then Swamishri blessed the assembly, "One who understands the glory of God and obeys His commands is liberated, and he becomes happy in this world and the next..." Then Swamishri bathed Shri Harikrishna Maharaj with the holy water of Godavari brought from the Kumbh Mela and the holy water of rivers Ghela, Utavali and Falgu. Swamishri and senior sadhus made the customary five rounds in a boat and performed arti of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Ganeshji. Thereafter Swamishri immersed the murti of Shri Ganeshji. On reaching the river shore, Swamishri applied the holy water on his head and sprinkled it on Pujya Mahant Swami, sadhus and devotees. About 4,500 devotees attended the festival.

Every year prior to the Jal Jhilani festival, Swamishri's Thakorji, Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, is carried in a decorative palanquin in a devotional procession of sadhus and devotees in Sarangpur village. This year, a newly ornate palanquin was prepared by sadhus and brought before Swamishri. On seeing it Swamishri immediately assessed, "The seating space in the palanquin is very confined and deep. How will people have darshan of Thakorji during the procession?"

In a single glance, Swamishri perceived that the principal purpose of Thakorji's darshan in the palanquin would not be served. The devotees would not be able to have Thakorji's darshan and be blessed by His divine vision. The sadhus made the necessary changes for Thakorji's darshan.

Nilkanth Varni Pratishtha For the first time in Europe, Swamishri installed the murti of Bhagwan Shri Nilkanth Varni at Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Neasden. Doctor Swami performed the initial rituals after which Swamishri completed the murti-pratishtha just after 10.15 am. Swamishri then performed the very first abhishek (ritual bathing) of the murti. In his blessings Swamishri praised the devotees for their devotion and love. He also prayed for the fulfilment of the wishes of those who come to perform abhishek of Nilkanth Varni. As a mark of devotion and gratitude to Nilkanth Varni's sacrifice and compassion for humanity, devotees will daily offer abhishek to the murti of Nilkanth Varni by bathing the sacred image with sanctified water from holy rivers the world over.

After renouncing His home at the tender age of 11, Bhagwan Swaminarayan commenced a journey of spiritual awakening across the length and breadth of India - during which He came to be known as Nilkanth Varni. Barefooted, Nilkanth walked alone covering 12,000 kilometres over 7 years.

As a tribute to His divine sojourns, on Monday 6 September, for the first time in Europe, His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj installed the murti of Bhagwan Shri Nilkanth Varni at Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Neasden. This day was etched in history as it was the first time Swamishri had installed a murti at the Mandir since its opening in 1995. Pujya Doctor Swami performed the initial rituals after which Swamishri completed the image installation just after 10:15am. Swamishri then performed the very first abhishek (ritual bathing) of the murti. Later in his blessings Swamishri was in a joyful mood and praised the devotees for their devotion and love. He also prayed for the fulfilment of the wishes of those who come to perform abhishek of Nilkanth Varni.

As a mark of devotion and gratitude to Nilkanth Varni's sacrifice and compassion for humanity, devotees will daily offer abhishek to the murti of Nilkanth Varni by bathing the sacred image with sanctified water from holy rivers the world over.

Today was Sam Shravani, and as per the annual custom, all sadhus and Samvedi Brahmins change their sacred threads. After Swamishri’s puja and the conclusion of the Vedic rituals, Swamishri donned the new janoi before removing the old one.

A youth enquired of Swamishri as to what he should do to make his life successful. Swamishri briefly answered by highlighting three principles, “Firstly, one must have faith in God. Secondly, read the shastras and abide by the laws prescribed by God. This means you must stay away from addictions and adultery. Then God will be happy upon you, and God’s blessings will enable you to achieve success. Thirdly, always keep the company of good (virtuous) people. If you have good company in your social affairs, satsang and at work then you will progress in life.”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

The evening assembly commemorated the BAPS Centenary Year. The celebration programme was interspersed with speeches by senior sadhus and cultural dances by balaks, kishores and yuvaks. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the congregation, “The root of the Centenary Celebration is Shastriji Maharaj. He was a God-realized sadhu, and God worked through him. He never desired for worldly fame or that countless people revere him. He wished only to spread the knowledge of Akshar Purushottam and liberate the jivas. But in this world the good always face problems. Bhagwan Ram, Krishna and Swaminarayan faced difficulties and opposition. Those who fail to understand oppose and create problems, but the truth always prevails.”

In the evening satsang assembly a traditional dance was performed to welcome Thakorji and Swamishri by children and teenage members of the Dehgam Satsang centre. Then senior sadhus honoured Swamishri with garlands. Thereafter a drama ‘Vajesinh Darbar’s Hoko’ was performed by the youth members of Ahmedabad Satsang centre. Blessing the congregation, Swamishri said, “Normally, we find that people take pride in being rich, in having a high position or power. Many times people are in high spirits after returning from a trip abroad or seeing a film. They feel elated in such ordinary things. But their joy is short-lived and does not bring peace to them. All material happiness is fleeting, whereas God’s divine happiness is inexhaustible and eternal.” More than 18,000 devotees attended the Sunday satsang assembly.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of the marble murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Radha-Krishna Dev, Shiv-Parvatiji, Hanumanji and Ganapatji and Guru Parampara (canvas) for the BAPS hari mandir in Albany, Georgia, USA.

During the month of Shravan, Aksharesh Swami had gone to various centres to hold kirtan aradhanas (devotional singing programmes). He was giving Pramukh Swami Maharaj a report of these kirtan aradhanas. He said, "In Barshi (Maharashtra), a fine mandir has been built."
Swamishri immediately said, "It is the power of Pritam Swami."

Years ago Pritamprasad Swami used to go to Barshi often and nurture satsang there. After that he has not even gone there for many years, but Swamishri has remembered that seva and dedication of years ago right up to today, and when the moment came he even recalled it! Swamishri remembers everyone's seva, small or large.
There was a letter from a spiritual seeker. Sincerely describing the natures that troubled him, he had written, "Lust troubles me a great deal. I try, but I cannot conquer my nature."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave that devotee blessings over the phone and said, "Keep trying. Overcoming it is in our hands. Stop looking at and reading worldly things. Remember God. Turn extra malas."
The seeker said, "Even though we practise satsang, this happens."
Swamishri said, "We practise satsang, but we also end up seeing worldly things. That is why these thoughts come. Observe the niyams properly, and God will make things right."
Mukeshbhai Vadher phoned from Rajkot. His grandson had passed away in an accident. Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave him blessings and comfort over the phone.
Finally Mukeshbhai said, "Bapa! In his memory, should we distribute patasa (sugar drops) or sakar (sugar crystals)?"
Swamishri immediately said, "For us there is no mourning, there is joy, so do whatever you wish." After giving this guidance, the phone call ended.
Swamishri said, "Such poor people with firm conviction face sorrow, but how good their understanding is!"

Meetings were going on about the Akshardham to be built in New Jersey. At the end, Harshadbhai Chavda, who was present at the meeting, made a request to Pramukh Swami Maharaj: "I wanted to retire now, but this seva has come along. Otherwise I wanted to retire and live in Gondal. I have even built a two storey house there."
Swamishri immediately asked in surprise, "Why?"
Harshadbhai said, "I had the thought that we would live there after retirement."
Swamishri immediately stopped him and said, "For us, this activity is itself our retirement."
Harshadbhai said, "At present I have given the keys to the mandir, and the mandir is using it."

Swamishri said, "Your house will be used only for the mandir's work, devotees will stay there. The mandir itself is your home. When there was the mandir, why did you build a house? You have every right to stay in the mandir."
What wonderful affection Swamishri has!!

During the month of Shravan, Akshresh Swami had gone to different centres to hold kirtan aradhana programmes. He was giving Pramukh Swami Maharaj a report of these programmes. He said, "In Barsi (Maharashtra) the mandir has come up well."
Swamishri immediately said, "That is the glory of Pritam Swami."

Years ago, Pritamprasad Swami used to go to Barsi often and nurture the satsang there. After that he had not gone there for many years, but Swamishri had remembered his seva and dedication of years ago to this very day, and when the time came he recalled it too! Swamishri remembers everyone's seva, big or small.

Today, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was going from the Akshardham monument towards the abhishek mandap, seeing the podium joining the two ends of the Akshardham circumambulation, the sadhus recalled an incident of Swamibapa: "The wonderful decision not to close this circumambulation but to keep its ends open was Swamibapa's."
Hearing this, adding dignity to his guru's virtue, Swamishri said, "...And he never recalled it again...!! (that this decision was his.)"
What a subtle vision for appreciating the deeds of his guru!

In the evening, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the "Indo American Community Day" assembly. Along with leaders of the Hindu community, Shri Chintubhai Patel (Amneal Pharmaceuticals), one of the American leaders who champion good relations between India and America, said in his speech:

"I am totally speechless. I am so humbled and honored to be standing on the same stage as His Holiness Shri Mahant Swami Maharaj. I am very lucky. Fifteen minutes back, I was able to get his blessings. Certain phenomena in this life cannot be described by words and that was my experience. I felt divinity coming out of him; love and warmth that I have never experienced before.

This was the same experience that I had when I first met Pramukh Swami Maharaj, and I can assure you that the same divinity and love I had experienced then, I experienced today. So, the guru is always here and their blessings are flowing from generation to generation and we all are lucky to have the great Mahant Swami Maharaj here."

(In Gujarati:) "I am completely speechless. Standing on the stage where Mahant Swami Maharaj is seated, I feel humbled and honoured. I am very fortunate. Just fifteen minutes ago I received his blessings. Some events in life cannot be expressed in words, and that was my experience. I felt divinity, love and warmth spreading from him, which I had never experienced before.

This was just like the experience I had when I first met Pramukh Swami Maharaj. And I can tell you with certainty that the same divinity and love I experienced then, I experienced today. So the guru is always here, and his blessings keep showering from generation to generation. We are all fortunate that we have Mahant Swami Maharaj here..."

st.t: Kids Creations - 256 - The Mission Rajipo Bash
w: You must have heard – more than 15,000 children learned the entire Satsang Diksha by heart in Sanskrit. Swamishri graced them all on 29 October through a special online sabha.

Did you catch the program? What was your favourite part? Was it when Swamishri saw the ginormous pendo? Or when everyone opened their mouths wide to gulp down the sheero he offered us? Or was it when he sprinkled flower petals on the heads of the two boys in sunflower costumes?

My favorite part was when Bapa told us that he is so, so, so, so raaji with us for doing mukhpath. I felt so proud of myself because all summer, I have been memorizing the Satsang Diksha just for one thing. Not a simple thing. The best thing. Bapa’s rajipo! Aditya Shroff (10) Los Angeles, California United States

My favorite part was when the boy said, ‘Have ave chhe phakta ek pendo…’ And then, when the pendo was revealed, it was gigantic! And then, Bapa’s expression was amazing. Ananti Naik (7) London, United Kingdom

My fav part was when the kids all got Maharaj and Swami's rajipo. The most fav thing I also liked was when Mahant Swami was so happy that all the kids learned the whole book. If I were Mahant Swami, I also would be raaji (happy). It was very meaningful to me because the kids worked so hard to get Maharaj’s rajipo. This means they have great dedication for satsang. It was best for them, and Maharaj was very happy. It was also fantastic. Gyanvi (9) South Elgin, Illinois
My favourite part was when Bapa presented his gift to us: The Heart Book. It was touching to see how much hard work he had put in to make a gift for us. Dhairya Patel (12) London, United Kingdom

My favourite part of the whole sabha was when Bapa ate the pendo. It was a memorable part. Also, since I am a vidvan, I also got to take labh of this sabha. Another memorable moment was when the little boy said, ‘Beta… mukhpath thai gayo?’ This whole sabha was really good, and I enjoyed it. Kashish Patel (12) Wellingborough, United Kingdom

I got to join this incredible sabha via Zoom call as a vidvan. My favorite bit was definitely when Bapa promised to eat one pendo, then the cloth was taken off to reveal an absolutely MASSIVE pendo. It was a very funny and memorable smruti. Darshan Tailor (14) Enfield, London, United Kingdom

My favourite part of the program was when the balak told Bapa to close the eyes, and he opened his eyes early, and balak again two times asked Bapa to close his eyes. This was as if Bapa was blinking and it reminded me of Bapa's darshan I did on 6 Sept 2024 in Mumbai, and at that time also, Bapa had blinked his eyes while looking at me. Thank you Bapa for the beautiful smruti. Varni Mukund Kariya (6) Pune, Maharashtra, India

Jay Swaminaryan. When I saw the video of Bapa on YouTube, I felt deeply felt drawn to the bit when he fed all of us sheero. That’s because he showed how proud he was to be seeing all of the nakar vidvans accomplish his dream and goal that he wanted us to do. Jansi Patel (11) Brisbane, Queensland, Australia
My favorite memory is when Bapa gave us the sheero. Personally, I love sheero, so this memory will always stay with me. Pooja Patel (12) Houston, Texas, United States
